title: Preserve ordering of `font-*` properties that follow a `font` shorthand
author: samizdatco
summary: FontHandler buffers the `font` shorthand but emits unknown font-* longhands (font-variant-numeric, font-kerning, ...) immediately, so they land before the shorthand and get reset by it. The PR flushes the pending shorthand before emitting such a property. Real rendering bug with a small, targeted fix.
evidence: master 574eee2 CLI --minify: `.foo{font:12px serif;font-variant-numeric:oldstyle-nums;font-kerning:none}` -> `.foo{font-variant-numeric:oldstyle-nums;font-kerning:none;font:12px serif}` (longhands now reset by the shorthand). stof flagged the author's earlier 'discard longhands' optimization as unsafe (shorthand may be unsupported); author reverted it. No maintainer comments. Review: matches only CustomPropertyName::Unknown starting with 'font-'; check font-* longhands lightningcss does parse but FontHandler doesn't own (e.g. font-variant-caps handling, font-palette, font-feature-settings), and the flush interplay with prefixes/fallbacks.
